source: Jobstreet by SEEK Malaysia and Randstad Malaysia, reported by The Edge Malaysia
extraction_note: Skill names below are the ones the cited article explicitly names as areas of concentrated demand. They are NOT scraped percentages: the article names the areas but publishes no per-skill percentages, so no percentage is attached to an individual skill.

headline_facts.fact: ICT-related job postings grew nearly 25% year-on-year in 2025
headline_facts.basis: Jobstreet by SEEK Malaysia, quoted in the article
headline_facts.fact_zh: 2025 年 ICT 相关招聘广告同比增长近 25%
headline_facts.fact_ms: Iklan kerja berkaitan ICT meningkat hampir 25% tahun ke tahun pada 2025

headline_facts.fact: 36% of job advertisements now list specific skill requirements as the primary filter, often ahead of formal qualifications
headline_facts.basis: Jobstreet by SEEK Malaysia, quoted in the article
headline_facts.fact_zh: 36% 的招聘广告把具体技能要求列为首要筛选条件，往往排在正式学历之前
headline_facts.fact_ms: 36% iklan kerja kini menyenaraikan keperluan kemahiran khusus sebagai penapis utama, selalunya mendahului kelayakan formal

headline_facts.fact: Skilled workers earn 72% more than low-skilled counterparts
headline_facts.basis: Department of Statistics Malaysia, cited in the article
headline_facts.fact_zh: 技术工人的收入比低技能劳动者高 72%
headline_facts.fact_ms: Pekerja mahir memperoleh 72% lebih tinggi berbanding rakan berkemahiran rendah

headline_facts.fact: Data-centre mechanical and electrical professionals can command 20%-50% pay increases, versus 5%-10% for most professionals
headline_facts.basis: Randstad Malaysia, cited in the article
headline_facts.fact_zh: 数据中心机电专业人员的薪资涨幅可达 20%–50%，而多数专业岗位为 5%–10%
headline_facts.fact_ms: Profesional mekanikal dan elektrik pusat data boleh mendapat kenaikan gaji 20%–50%, berbanding 5%–10% bagi kebanyakan profesional
